description: React component for a code editor wrapper using CodeMirror, supporting syntax highlighting, line highlighting, error display, and link handling.

methods.name: onCodeMirrorClick
methods.description: Handles click events on links within the code editor to open URLs in a new tab.

methods.name: defineCustomMode
methods.description: Defines a custom CodeMirror mode for linkified text if not already defined.

methods.name: mimeTypeToMode
methods.description: Converts MIME types to CodeMirror mode strings.

methods.name: highlighterToMode
methods.description: Maps highlighter types to CodeMirror mode strings.
